notes: The following rewards were awarded during this event, based on event points accumulated over the course of the event:

rows.text: Title: Chemistry of Combustion! Maddox Sogetsu of the Secrecy! Completed

notes: When Dueling against Maddox Sogetsu Level 40 or higher, these are the only cards that can drop; at lower levels, cards from the standard pool for Legendary Duelists may also drop. Dueling Burning Flames! Maddox Sogetsu and the Yudias Velgear, Chupataro Kaburagi, or Terza Flatwood spawned by this effect will also drop cards from this pool.

"Masaki the Legendary Swordsman", "Red Medicine", “Lizard Soldier”, “Vishwar Randi”

notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remains open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
